title: 第25章 快饿死的泰坦血牛第26章 奇葩的进阶之路
slug: 御兽别人鉴定都是骗你开神兽

唐柏在屏幕外歉意一笑。
“抱歉，还得麻烦你再等一会。”
“这地方实在是太大了，除了御兽的主人之外，要想找到血牛几乎是不可能的。”
“我表妹已经在赶来的路上了，你稍等一会。”
在等待的过程中，唐柏也不露脸，也不说话。
就这么将摄像头对准了草原，隔上一会像是担心直播间的人看烦了，他还会贴心的转个方向。
小半个小时后，一道倩影匆匆而来。
人还没有出现，急切的呼喊声就传进了直播间里。
“表哥，你又帮我找到医生了？”
“这次是哪个医院的名医？还是其他城市御兽心理协会的专家？”
“医生在哪里？我怎么没看到人？”
唐柏一把按住快要蹦起来的唐雯，将手机转过去对着她。
一个萌萌哒玩偶脑袋人像出现在唐雯的眼中。
几乎是在瞬间，她双眼中满含期望的光泽，在看到陈小草的时候立刻暗淡下去，并浮起浓浓的厌弃和防备。
“表哥，你不要告诉我，这就是你为我找来的医生？”
唐雯一把从唐柏手中夺走手机，看着陈小草，警告道。
“我可不是那么好骗的人，如果你收了我表哥的钱，我劝你赶紧退还回来，否则我一定会将这件事上报治安所。”
“我唐家的能量，不是你这种死骗子能想象的！”
“如果明天我还看不到退款，不管你在哪里，我都会找到你，让你付出代价！”

说完，唐雯扭头就要走。
唐柏赶忙拉住她，柔声劝道。
“表妹，这个主播真的有点东西的，你相信我，我还能害你不成？”
“你不如就让她。。。”
“让她骗我吗？”
已经要走的唐雯被唐柏一喊，猛地转过身来，恶狠狠的瞪着唐柏吼道。
“让她给我希望又让我失望？”
“让她说一堆我耳朵都听起茧子了的话？”
“然后让我像你一样，被别人骗一次、两次、三次？”
“哥！你醒醒吧！没人能帮得了你，也没人能帮得了我！”
说到激动处，唐雯一巴掌将唐柏手里的手机打翻，恨恨的道。
“钱多也不能像你一样一直傻乎乎的给别人送吧？你都被骗多少次了？八次？还是十次？你什么时候才能长长记性！”
【啧，说起来你们可能不信，我看着看着直播，直接被人一嘴巴子呼脸上了。】
【呵~谁不是呢，这娘们好大的气性。】
【狗：我不知道啊，我就蹲在路边看戏来着，这娘们过来就是给我一个大逼斗。】
【主播，走！咱不受这个鸟气！】
【要是这娘们知道主播能精准识别御兽蛋，不知道她会是什么脸色，一整个期待住了。】
【那个，你们别忘了，现在人家才是债主，小主播可是欠债的那个，受个气值两百万，这气我只想说，给我多来点。】
【emmm，说的也有道理，不过咱们这一巴掌也不能白挨，我要这娘们亲自把我从地上捡起来，然后给我道歉，这样才能原谅她。】
【臣附议！】

【臣附议！】
【主播你说句话啊！咱这些大臣们都在给你冲锋陷阵，你可不能糊涂啊！】
同样莫名其妙挨了一巴掌的陈小草有些尴尬的扣了扣鼻子。
怎么说呢？难道这些网友都不知道什么叫做债主才是爹吗？
这一巴掌。。。反正又不疼，挨了也就挨了嘛，只要能先把账还上，挨一巴掌还是可以接受的嘛。

Tang Bai smiled apologetically outside the screen.
"Sorry, I have to trouble you to wait a little longer."
"This place is really too big. Except for the owner of the beast, it is almost impossible to find the blood cow."
"My cousin is already on her way, please wait a moment."
While waiting, Tang Bai didn't show his face or speak.
Just like that, he pointed the camera at the grassland. After a while, as if he was worried that the people in the live broadcast room would get tired of watching, he would considerately turn it in another direction.
Less than half an hour later, a beautiful shadow came in a hurry.
Before anyone showed up, urgent shouts came into the live broadcast room.
"Cousin, have you helped me find a doctor again?"
"Which hospital's famous doctor is this time? Or is it an expert from another city's Animal Control Psychological Association?"
"Where is the doctor? Why don't I see anyone?"
Tang Bai held down Tang Wen who was about to jump up and turned the phone to face her.
A cute doll head appeared in Tang Wen's eyes.
Almost instantly, the luster in her eyes, which was full of expectation, dimmed immediately when she saw Chen Xiaocao, and a strong sense of disgust and defensiveness emerged.
"Cousin, don't tell me that this is the doctor you found for me?"
Tang Wen snatched the phone from Tang Bai's hand, looked at Chen Xiaocao, and warned.
"I'm not that easy to deceive. If you accept money from my cousin, I advise you to return it as soon as possible, otherwise I will definitely report the matter to the police station."
"The energy of my Tang family is beyond what a dead liar like you can imagine!"
"If I don't see a refund tomorrow, no matter where you are, I will find you and make you pay!"
After saying that, Tang Wen turned around and left.
Tang Bai quickly grabbed her and persuaded her softly.
"Cousin, this anchor is really good. If you believe me, can I still harm you?"
"Why don't you just let her..."
"Let her lie to me?"
Tang Wen, who was about to leave, turned around suddenly when Tang Bai shouted, glared at Tang Bai fiercely and shouted.
"For her to give me hope and then disappoint me?"
"Let her say a bunch of words that make my ears ring with cocoons?"
"Then let me be cheated by others once, twice, or three times like you?"
"Brother! Wake up! No one can help you, and no one can help me!"
Speaking of excitement, Tang Wen knocked the cell phone out of Tang Bai's hand with a slap and said bitterly.
"You can't just stupidly give away money to others like you, right? How many times have you been deceived? Eight times? Or ten times? When will you be able to have a long memory!"
[Tsk, you may not believe it, but when I watched the live broadcast, I was slapped in the face. 】
[Haha~ Who is not? This girl is so angry. 】
[Dog: I don’t know, I was squatting on the roadside watching a show, and this bitch came over just to give me a big pussy fight. 】
[Anchor, let’s go! We don't tolerate this nonsense! 】
[If this girl knew that the anchor could accurately identify the beast eggs, I don’t know what her face would be like. I was really looking forward to it. 】
[Well, don’t forget, people are the creditors now, and the little anchor is the one who owes the debt. The anger is worth two million. I just want to say, give me more of this anger. 】
[Emmm, that makes sense, but we can’t get this slap in vain. I want this bitch to pick me up off the ground and apologize to me, so that I can forgive her. 】
[I second the motion! 】
[I second the motion! 】
[Anchor, please say something! We ministers are all charging into battle for you, so you can’t be confused! 】
Chen Xiaocao, who was also slapped inexplicably, pressed his nose in embarrassment.
How to say it? Don’t these netizens know what it means that the creditor is the father?
This slap. . . Anyway, it doesn't hurt, so if you get hit, you'll get it. As long as you can pay off the debt first, a slap is still acceptable.
